definitions.gloss: ordinary; average; on a par with other people
definitions.explanation: Being at the level most people are at, neither better nor worse: an ordinary life, average ability, the usual feelings. Often used modestly about oneself, or in wishing for no more than an ordinary life.

examples.japanese: {人並|ひとな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧がしたい。
examples.english: I want to live an ordinary life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人並|ひとな}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can cook about as well as the next person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人並|ひとな}み⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧で、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: She has an extraordinary memory and never forgets a face she has seen once.

notes:
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (people) + {並|な}み (the common level). Takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun ({人並|ひとな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：02368_shiawase⟧) and ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb ({人並|ひとな}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人並|ひとな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ / ⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：02368_shiawase⟧: an ordinary life / ordinary happiness
- {人並|ひとな}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as well as anyone, to an ordinary degree
- {人並|ひとな}み⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: extraordinary, far beyond the ordinary
- {人並|ひとな}み⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: more than most people

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{人波|ひとなみ}→人波：28183_hitonami⟧: a surging crowd — same sound, different word
